findings.title: The program's goals G1–G4 have no graded reading
findings.recommendation: Each stage's exits are graded, but nothing grades the four goals the stages trace to. Record a goal reading at arc-done, as clean-up-review-cycle's status log did: G2, G3 and G4 can be graded on the archived records now (the claims check, the pending-rewrite list emptied, the sweeps over README and docs/), while G1 ('a newcomer following the README installs orbit and runs its core loop') is graded only by landing-page's post-flip run.

findings.title: reference-docs carries no Shipped-as paragraph
findings.recommendation: The other four stages each close with a 'Shipped as' paragraph under their exits; reference-docs' outcome lives only in the status log (lines 351-360). Add its paragraph after its exits, from that entry, so every stage section reads the same way and a stage slice (orbit architecture show) carries what shipped.

findings.title: Considered & out does not record the dropped Windows support
findings.recommendation: Dropping CI's Windows leg (Sal, at public-readiness's apply) is a direction the program weighed and rejected, but it is recorded only inside public-readiness's Shipped-as paragraph. Add a dated Considered & out entry naming the reason (198 failures from causes outside the program, a pwsh leg that could not fail) and issue #23 as where it now lives.

findings.title: The Tier-C scrub entry does not say where the deferred work now lives
findings.recommendation: Sal chose on 2026-10-13 to end the program and track the remaining user-visible OpenSpec strings in issue #24 ('Refine Documentation'), with the architect-first Quickstart. The Considered & out entry and R-ugd-3 still read as an open-ended deferral. Append to the entry that the work is tracked in #24 for after the program, so the rejected direction points at its continuation.

findings.title: The status log's remaining-work list is now partly done
findings.recommendation: The last entry lists deleting the eleven past-stage branches as remaining; they were deleted on 2026-10-13 (origin now holds main only), and issue #24 opened. The log is append-only, so append an entry recording the branch deletion, issue #24, and this closing review, leaving the visibility flip, the description and topics, and landing-page's post-flip run and ratification as what remains.

commentary: Read whole (395 lines) against orbit architecture status. The doc holds together: every stage charter traces to a goal, every stage has falsifiable exits, Depends-on matches the sequencing prose with no cycle, and the four carve-outs from R-ugd-3 each name their exact reach. The supersession chain R-ugd-6 → 7 → 8 → 9 is annotated in place, so no ruling reads as live where it is not. What is thin is the arc-close layer: goals never graded, one stage without its Shipped-as, and two rejected directions (Windows, the CLI scrub's continuation) recorded only in passing. None changes a stage's state. landing-page's exit (3) is the one open item, and it waits on Sal's flip by design. First architecture review for this doc.
